extracted.name: Apple Cider Cocktail
extracted.description: This apple cider cocktail recipe is a great fall drink. Made with bourbon, ginger beer, lemon juice, and bitters, it's bright, warming, and delicious. We love to make it for fall gatherings or cozy nights in!
instruction_lines: Fill a rocks glass with ice. Add the bourbon, apple cider, bitters. Top with the ginger beer and gently stir. Add a squeeze of lemon, if desired.
Garnish with a cinnamon stick, star anise, apple slice, and/or fresh thyme and serve.
